description: Save per-brand calendar pacing laws enforced by queue_add and queue_shuffle and previewed in drafts_validate: minGapHours (0 to 168), separateLanguagesByDay (true or false), noRepeatDays (0 to 365) and avoidBackToBackPillar (true or false). Send one or more rules to update; omitted rules keep their current values. Posts already scheduled keep their times.

avoidBackToBackPillar.description: When true, avoids queuing two posts from the same content pillar or series back-to-back on an account.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

minGapHours.description: Minimum hours between any two posts on the same account, an integer from 0 to 168 (0 turns it off).

noRepeatDays.description: Skip queue slots within this many days of the same caption or linked topic/keyword on an account, an integer from 0 to 365 (0 turns it off).

separateLanguagesByDay.description: When true, posts written in different languages (from topics_link, options.language or lang: tags) are never queued on the same local day on an account.

name: queue_rules_set
title: Set calendar pacing rules
